value.rationale: The two-order source motivates whether more independently nonlinear game sizes can create additional cooperative phases. The theorem rules out any third isolated interior phase across even a countable spectrum, supplies necessary-and-sufficient bistability data and realizes the maximum with three genuinely nonlinear sizes. This is a structural restriction of a natural expanding model class, not just a numerical example or table entry.
